answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks with physical proof-of-encounter graphs. Agents sign edges only via sub-meter NFC handshakes, forming a sparse vouching trellis where bounded random walks from anchors reject clones behind narrow cuts. Scaling fake identities requires fresh physical contacts with honest peers, imposing travel and device costs per batch. Yet barriers like a river or outages during a gale create graph bottlenecks that can isolate honest clusters.
